## Adversarial findings — SKIPPED (all backends unreachable)

Every configured backend was unreachable, so this build shipped without adversarial review. The chain had one backend, openai/fixture-model, which returned HTTP 503 (fixture unavailable); the helper exited 5 and marked the primary reviewer as skipped. This is an advisory autonomous run, so the skip is recorded as a chain outage rather than a block. No Phase 2 findings exist, so critical escalation does not apply.
